entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_01
entries.text: I’ve been waiting for a fiery challenger like you![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_30
entries.text: Taking on the Elite Four pretty much right after\ncoming to our school? Now that’s lit![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_31
entries.text: No wonder Kieran and Drayton like you.[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_32
entries.text: And if I’m being honest, you’ve kindled my\ncuriosity too![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_33
entries.text: I should warn you, though—my trial is no\ncakewalk![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_02
entries.text: My Elite Trial is...[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]putting together a super-spicy[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]sandwich[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_03
entries.text: And I mean SUPER-spicy! I want something so\nhot it’ll have me breathing flames![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_04
entries.text: I know what you’re thinking—that sounds easy,\nright? But you can’t use your own ingredients![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_34
entries.text: You have to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]negotiate[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] with the League Club\nmembers around here to get what you need![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_05
entries.text: Once you think you have all the right ingredients,\ncome back and talk to me.[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_06
entries.text: Then I’ll judge your sandwich-making skills\nwith my own two eyes![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_07
entries.text: The key to cooking any dish is picking the right\ningredients. The rest is easy as pie![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_08
entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Are you ready to take on my Elite Trial,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_01
entries.text: I’m ready!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_02
entries.text: Explain again?

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_03
entries.text: Maybe later

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_09
entries.text: Sweet! Gimme a hot minute to get everything\nset up![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_10
entries.text: First things first—negotiate with the League\nClub members to get some ingredients.[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_11
entries.text: You need to make a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]super-spicy sandwich[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]! That\nshould already be a clue for what you need.[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_12
entries.text: Once you’ve got all the ingredients to whip up\nyour sandwich, come gimme a holler![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_akamatsu_13
entries.text: All right then! Let’s start this...now![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower01_01
entries.text: Do you want mayonnaise? I’ll share some with\nyou, but only if you can defeat me!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower_select_01
entries.text: I’ll battle you!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower_select_02
entries.text: No thanks

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower01_05
entries.text: Oh, it’s may-on now!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower01_06
entries.text: Guess you’re not a mayonnaise fan.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower01_02
entries.text: Here’s some mayonnaise, like I promised.\nIt’s really good, so...spread the word!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower01_03
entries.text: Mayonnaise has a lot of vinegar in it. That’s why\nit’s sour. Sour like life.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower01_heal
entries.text: Here, let me heal up your Pokémon so there’s\nno sour feelings between us.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower01_04
entries.text: [EMPTY 169]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower02_01
entries.text: I’ve got some potato salad if you want! You’ll\nhave to beat me in battle to get it, though!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower02_05
entries.text: I’ll mash you like a potato!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower02_06
entries.text: Aww, no love for potato salad?

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower02_02
entries.text: My potato salad says it wants to go with you!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower02_heal
entries.text: There’s something so restorative about carrying\npotato salad around, don’t you think?

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower02_03
entries.text: Potato salad’s nice because it’s not spicy at all!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower02_04
entries.text: [EMPTY 169]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_01
entries.text: We all know jalapeños are super spicy! And guess\nwhat? I’ve got some!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_02
entries.text: And I’ll also have you know I’m good at battles.\nLike, really good.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_03
entries.text: [EMPTY 169]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_04
entries.text: You look like you want jalapeños, so I’ll give you\na choice. Do you want to battle me for some?\r\nOr buy some off me for 50 BP?

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_04
entries.text: I’ll battle you!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_05
entries.text: I’ll buy!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_06
entries.text: I’ll pass on both

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_05
entries.text: Like I said, I’m really strong. I think you might\nregret your decision.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_06
entries.text: I see you’re a jalapeño-worthy Trainer.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_heal
entries.text: Here, let me heal your Pokémon after all that.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_07
entries.text: Why battle when you could buy instead, eh?\nI like the way you think.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_08
entries.text: You don’t have enough BP, though. You can’t\nmake a deal with anybody like that.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_09
entries.text: A piece of advice—don’t rub your eyes after\nhandling jalapeños.

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower03_10
entries.text: [EMPTY 169]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower04_01
entries.text: Let’s see if you can get this trivia question! If you\ndo, I’ll give you three ingredients!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower04_02
entries.text: What do you get when you mix eggs, oil, and\nvinegar? Tell me, if you’ve got it!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_select_08
entries.text: No idea

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower04_03
entries.text: Correct! The answer is mayonnaise! You’ve got\nfive-star knowledge, I see!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_a_02_follower04_04
entries.text: And here’s your prize—three whole ingredients\nat once!
